mcp.setup.connectedDescription: Rhizome is already connected to external AI tools for this vault. Reconnect to refresh the configuration, or disconnect to remove Rhizome from those third-party config files.
mcp.setup.setupDescription: Rhizome can add its MCP server to external AI tools for this vault, but it will not touch third-party config files until you confirm here.
mcp.setup.runtimeRequirement: This setup requires Node.js 18+ or Bun 1+ on PATH and an MCP-compatible desktop tool. Rhizome checks the runtime before writing config so the tool is not left pointing at a broken command.
mcp.setup.writeEntryDescription: Confirming this action will write or update Rhizome's single {entry} MCP entry in:
mcp.setup.clientPathsDescription: Claude Code CLI reads ~/.claude.json, Antigravity CLI reads ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json, Cursor reads ~/.cursor/mcp.json, and the generic ~/.config/mcp/mcp.json path is picked up by other MCP-compatible tools using mcpServers. OpenCode reads ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json and uses its top-level mcp map. Closing leaves all files untouched unless you connect or disconnect, reconnecting is idempotent, and disconnecting removes Rhizome's entry again.
mcp.setup.geminiGuidanceDescription: Antigravity CLI needs its own install and sign-in. Use Restore Rhizome AI Guidance when you want a vault-root GEMINI.md compatibility shim that points Antigravity back to the shared AGENTS.md instructions without overwriting custom guidance.
